visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with five male chefs standing in a row against a beige background, wearing white chef uniforms and smiling at the camera. Text overlays and logos appear at the top and bottom. (2) Two of the chefs move into a studio kitchen setting, standing side-by-side and gesturing enthusiastically as they speak directly to the viewer. (3) A close-up shot displays a finished plate of Meigan Taro Pork, featuring glossy glazed meat and chunky taro pieces over dark greens. (4) Hands are seen pouring ingredients from a clear plastic pouch into a hot frying pan. A wooden spatula is used to stir-fry the dark vegetables and aromatics. (5) Broth is poured from a container into the pan, followed by a transition showing water being poured into the outer pot of a stainless steel electric rice cooker. (6) In a white bowl, slices of pork belly and taro are layered. The stir-fried mixture is then poured over the top. (7) A hand wearing a clear plastic glove presses a piece of plastic wrap onto the bowl and places it into the electric cooker, pressing the silver cook button. (8) After a quick cut, the bowl is taken out, and the contents are flipped onto a blue plate. A close-up shows a piece of pork being lifted with chopsticks, highlighting its texture. (9) A second dish, Spanish Seafood Stew Rice, is showcased on a plate with large shrimp and broccoli. (10) Cooking starts for this dish: shrimp are tossed in a pan with metal tongs, then liquid is added. (11) Yellow-colored rice and green broccoli are added to the pan and stirred. The camera zooms in on the simmering mixture. (12) The finished seafood rice is plated, with shrimp placed carefully on top of the yellow rice. (13) The two main chefs return to the studio kitchen to deliver a closing message, gesturing toward the camera. (14) The video ends with a group shot of the five chefs posing together again, with final text logos appearing on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic, high-pitched male group announcement followed by upbeat acoustic guitar music at 120 BPM. Clean studio acoustics are evident. (2) A sharp whoosh SFX marks the transition. Two male speakers engage in fast-paced, enthusiastic dialogue about a new collaboration. Their speech is clear and professionally projected. (3) A sizzling sound and a wet splash SFX are heard as the narrative voice describes adding ingredients to a hot pan. The music continues as a stable, rhythmic background. (4) A percussive thud followed by a metallic mechanical click is heard when the electric cooker is switched on. A faint ding SFX suggests the completion of a cooking phase. (5) The primary speaker continues in a joyful, high-valence tone, detailing the steps for a second dish. The music remains consistent with a strong beat. (6) A final stinger SFX ends the video following a high-energy call to action from both speakers. The overall sound design is polished and dense.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a commercial promoting a meal kit collaboration between FamilyMart's 'Fami煮煮' and the popular TV show 'Stylish Man - The Chef'. It aims to convince viewers that they can easily prepare professional-quality dishes like Meigan Taro Pork and Spanish Seafood Stew Rice at home using these kits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video prominently features brand logos, identifies the products as meal kits, and includes direct calls to action to download the FamilyMart app for purchase.
